description: How a member's fotolog page looks on foto-log.com: images the member uploaded for it.

main.description: One per member, with the record key 'self'. Every field is optional; a missing field means the member hasn't set that image.

titleImage.description: Shown across the top of the member page in place of the text title.

wallpaper.description: Fills the page behind and around the member page.

wallpaperMode.description: How the wallpaper fills the page: 'tile' repeats it at its natural size, 'fill' covers the window.

avatar.description: The member's profile photo on foto-log.com, in place of their Bluesky avatar.
